title: Spec-Drift Eval Case
description: One frozen offline spec-drift eval case: a labeled (diff, acceptance-criteria, expected-verdict) triple plus the frozen cheap-tier detector `analysis` fixture the pure classifier consumes, so the case can be scored offline and deterministically. Each line of evals/spec-drift/<split>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape. The holdout split is the immutable 0-false-positive baseline; changing a holdout expectation is a reviewed fixture change, never a tuning-loop side effect.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case (e.g. 'drift-ac-unimplemented'). Unique within a split and disjoint across dev/holdout (enforced by evals/validate-cases.py).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises and why the expected verdict is grounded (which AC drifted, or why the case is a false-positive trap).

tags.description: Optional labels for coverage tracking, e.g. 'fp-trap', 'true-positive', 'timeout', 'token-variant'.

acceptance_criteria.description: The story's acceptance criteria — the machine-readable spec the shipped diff is judged against, as parse_acceptance_criteria would emit them (one criterion per line, numbering stripped).

diff.description: The merged PR's unified diff (de-identified/synthetic). Grounds the scenario the frozen analysis is about; offline scoring reads `analysis`, not this field, but it documents what the detector was looking at.

analysis.description: The frozen cheap-tier detector output for this (diff, acceptance_criteria). Normally ends in a single `DRIFT_VERDICT: DRIFT|ALIGNED` line, exactly as build_drift_prompt instructs the model to emit. An empty string models a timeout/garbled tier (the INDETERMINATE path). This is the deterministic input the pure classify_drift consumes.

expected.description: The fixed, reward-hack-resistant expected verdict classify_drift must produce for this analysis.

verdict.description: Expected classifier verdict. A case whose verdict is ALIGNED or INDETERMINATE must never be classified DRIFT — doing so is a false positive the holdout gate forbids.
